This plot is not even mine — I rent it, so I do not want to put much money into it. Beans I grow mostly for the pot at home and maybe small sale if I have extra. I have no school and no cash to waste on fertilizer for beans on a borrowed piece of land, so I just use the seed I kept from last harvest and my own hands. My neighbors who grow beans also do not buy fertilizer for them — beans grow on their own if the rain is good.
